QuestInfo.name: Maple GM's Congrats on the 3 year Anniversary
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9010000##k wanted to show his appreciation to everyone in MapleStory for the support, and wants people to see him.
QuestInfo.1: MapleStory is now 3 years old all thanks to you!
QuestInfo.2: Hope you enjoy MapleStory for many years to come! The best is yet to come!

0.0: It's been 3 years since the Maple world was first created. We have prepared a special present to everyone that has helped us grow for the past 3 years. Would you accept it?

yes.0: The special present is actually a very special spell. This spell will definitely make you more powerful than ever. It'll take a little bit of time for me to prepare the spell, so talk to me in a bit.

no.0: Please allow me to say thank you.

1.0: I will now cast a spell on you called #bGM's Blessing#k.

yes.0: You have now been blessed with #bGM's Blessing#k. GM's Blessing will boost your stats for 1 hour.
yes.1: Also, you may only receive GM's Blessing once every 90 minutes. Please remember that #beven if you log off or if your blessing runs out, it'll still have to be 90 minutes after the blessing passes before you can receive another one#k, and if you want another one of the GM's Blessing, make sure to come see me.
yes.2: Have fun in the beautiful world of MapleStory!
